results.description:
# Salary
## Recent searches
- [Pay grades](https://pay-conditions.defence.gov.au/benefits/pay/salary#pay-grades)

Members are paid a military salary each fortnight. If you receive allowances or bonuses, they will be added to your salary.

If you're performing continuous full-time service in the Permanent Forces (SERCAT 7) or on SERVOP C, you're paid an annual rate.

If you're a member of the Reserves (SERCAT 2, 3, 4 or 5) doing reserve days, you're paid a [daily rate](https://pay-conditions.defence.gov.au/sites/default/files/2025-11/ADF-pay-rates-NOV2025.pdf).

## Increments
You'll usually get an increment advancement for every 12 months of full-time service at your rank. This stops once you reach the highest increment for your rank.

Your next increment will be 12 months from the date of your promotion.

## How to read salary rates tables
There are tables for members of the Permanent Forces and a table for Reserve members.

Ranks are listed by service, Army, Navy, Air Force. Look for your equivalent rank.

Example

You're a Lieutenant in the Army in the Permanent Forces who's at pay grade 4 and had one increment advancement.
